safety.homeSubtitle: Advisory guidelines for pilgrim and family safety
safety.do1: Always bathe only at officially designated, barricaded, and life-guarded ghats.
safety.do2: Keep an official emergency identity slip with contact numbers inside children's and seniors' pockets.
safety.do3: Stay calm during crowd surges and follow instructions announced by police and marshals.
safety.do4: Drink only sealed bottled water or municipal RO-tested public water fountains.
safety.dont1: Do not attempt swimming in prohibited deep reservoirs or barricaded river sections.
safety.dont2: Do not spread rumors or trust unverified forwards on messaging apps.
safety.dont3: Do not carry single-use plastics or throw items into the sacred Godavari river.
safety.dont4: Never touch unattended bags or suspicious items; notify on-duty police immediately on 112.
safety.emergencySubtitle: 24x7 emergency contacts, women and child protection, disaster management protocol
safety.womenSectionTitle: Dedicated Care for Women, Children & Senior Citizens
safety.womenSectionSubtitle: Specialized, sensitive, and secure facilities established across all major ghats.
safety.pinkBoothDesc: Dedicated booths staffed by female police personnel for prompt grievance redressal and immediate assistance.
safety.hirkaniDesc: Clean, air-conditioned, private spaces designated for nursing mothers and infant childcare.
safety.changingRoomDesc: 100+ waterproof, well-illuminated changing cubicles with round-the-clock female security personnel.
safety.lostChildTitle: Proposed 4-Step Protocol for Lost Persons (Reference Concept)
safety.lostChildSubtitle: Planned crowd management and lost person identification procedure — dial 112 in emergencies
safety.step1Desc: Visit any KumbhDoot Helpdesk, police booth, or volunteer post situated at all major ghats.
safety.step2Desc: Officer logs photo, clothing details, age, native language, and contact numbers onto the unified network.
safety.step3Desc: Synchronized public address system triggers simultaneous audio alerts across all ghats and stations.
safety.step4Desc: Pilgrim is escorted to a secure family waiting center with refreshments until relatives arrive.

transport.p2Desc: Serving pilgrims from Pune and South India. 15,000 vehicle capacity. Direct Dwarka-Panchavati transit.
transport.p3Desc: Designated for vehicles heading toward Trimbakeshwar. 8,000 capacity. Free e-buses to temple core.
transport.noVehicleDesc: On Shahi Snan days, all vehicular movement (two-wheelers and four-wheelers) is completely prohibited within a 2-km radius of Ramkund and Kushavarta Kund. Only authorized emergency ambulances and civic utility services are permitted.

about.standardsTitle: Portal Architecture & Technical Compliance (GIGW 3.0 & WCAG 2.1 AA)
about.standardsDesc: This MahaPortal is engineered in rigorous compliance with the Government of India Guidelines for Indian Government Websites (GIGW 3.0) and WCAG 2.1 AA standards. It guarantees seamless access for differently-abled citizens, senior pilgrims, and diverse linguistic groups.
about.stdItem1Text: Complete parity across Marathi (Primary), Hindi, and English.
about.stdItem2Text: High contrast toggle, text resizing (A- / A / A+), accessible screen reader tables.
about.stdItem3Text: Ultra-lightweight design engineered for instant loading in congested cellular zones.
